tools.name: supabase_get_profile
tools.description: Return the Supabase account that owns the access token: username and primary email. Use it to confirm which account is connected. Management API: GET /v1/profile.

tools.name: supabase_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the account can access, with id, slug, and name. Use the slug to filter projects. Management API: GET /v1/organizations.

tools.name: supabase_list_projects
tools.description: List all projects the account can access: ref, name, region, status, organization, and creation date. Start here to find a project ref. Management API: GET /v1/projects.

tools.name: supabase_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by ref: name, region, status, organization, creation date, and database details. Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}.

tools.name: supabase_get_project_health
tools.description: Check the health of selected project services (auth, db, pooler, realtime, rest, storage, pg_bouncer). Each result has status ACTIVE_HEALTHY, COMING_UP, or UNHEALTHY. Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/health.

tools.name: supabase_list_branches
tools.description: List the database branches of a project (preview branching), with status, parent project, and whether each is the default. Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/branches.

tools.name: supabase_list_functions
tools.description: List the Edge Functions deployed to a project: slug, status, version, and whether JWT verification is on. Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/functions.

tools.name: supabase_get_function
tools.description: Get one Edge Function's metadata by slug: status, version, verify_jwt, and entrypoint. It does not return the function source. Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/functions/{function_slug}.

tools.name: supabase_list_storage_buckets
tools.description: List the Storage buckets of a project with name, owner, public flag, and timestamps. Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/storage/buckets.

tools.name: supabase_list_secret_names
tools.description: List the names and last-update times of a project's Edge Function secrets. Secret values are never returned. Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/secrets (values removed).

tools.name: supabase_list_migrations
tools.description: List the database migrations applied to a project, by version and name, in order. Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/database/migrations.

tools.name: supabase_get_security_advisors
tools.description: Return the security lints for a project (for example tables without row level security, or exposed definitions). Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/advisors/security.

tools.name: supabase_get_performance_advisors
tools.description: Return the performance lints for a project (for example unindexed foreign keys or slow policies). Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/advisors/performance.

tools.name: supabase_get_typescript_types
tools.description: Generate TypeScript types for the database schemas of a project (default schema: public). Management API: GET /v1/projects/{ref}/types/typescript.

tools.name: supabase_run_read_only_query
tools.description: Run one SQL query on a project's database as the read-only role. Writes and DDL are rejected by the database. Use it to inspect data or counts. Management API: POST /v1/projects/{ref}/database/query/read-only.

tools.name: supabase_set_secrets
tools.description: Create or overwrite Edge Function secrets for a project (up to 100 per call). Names must not start with SUPABASE_. Values are sent to Supabase and never echoed back. Management API: POST /v1/projects/{ref}/secrets.

tools.name: supabase_delete_secrets
tools.description: Delete Edge Function secrets by name. Functions that read a deleted secret stop working until it is set again. Management API: DELETE /v1/projects/{ref}/secrets.

tools.name: supabase_pause_project
tools.description: Pause a project. Its database and APIs stop serving requests until it is restarted. Use only when the user asks for it. Management API: POST /v1/projects/{ref}/pause.

tools.name: supabase_restart_project
tools.description: Restart a project's services. Open connections are closed during the restart. Management API: POST /v1/projects/{ref}/restart.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "supabase_list_secret_names" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: supabase_get_profile, supabase_run_read_only_query, supabase_restart_project · Private data: supabase_get_profile, supabase_get_project, supabase_get_project_health, supabase_list_branches, supabase_list_secret_names, supabase_list_migrations, supabase_get_typescript_types, supabase_run_read_only_query, supabase_set_secrets, supabase_delete_secrets, supabase_pause_project · Public sink: supabase_get_profile, supabase_run_read_only_query, supabase_set_secrets, supabase_pause_project, supabase_restart_project · Destructive: supabase_run_read_only_query, supabase_set_secrets, supabase_delete_secrets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: supabase_get_profile, supabase_run_read_only_query, supabase_restart_project · Private data: supabase_get_profile, supabase_get_project, supabase_get_project_health, supabase_list_branches, supabase_list_secret_names, supabase_list_migrations, supabase_get_typescript_types, supabase_run_read_only_query, supabase_set_secrets, supabase_delete_secrets, supabase_pause_project · Public sink: supabase_get_profile, supabase_run_read_only_query, supabase_set_secrets, supabase_pause_project, supabase_restart_project · Destructive: supabase_run_read_only_query, supabase_set_secrets, supabase_delete_secrets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
